reviewer_role: fresh independent finite and error mathematical execution reviewer
scope: Complete submitted theorem, with emphasis on exact finite supports, all integer lags, clipping, quadrature, tails, floor and ceiling effects, objective and explicit quantifiers

theorem.model: Exactly Akwei Definition 7.2, real moment variables and noncyclic difference budgets

objections_and_dispositions.issue: A renewal jump near d=H could cause an untapered order x^-1 atom spreading error
objections_and_dispositions.disposition: Resolved analytically. Average the complete C_U+sigma inequality; C_U is Lipschitz through the jump. The submitted proof does not require a uniform two-sided approximation to the isolated atom term.

objections_and_dispositions.issue: Source cancellation is stated for s>0
objections_and_dispositions.disposition: Resolved by exact integer support. The medium regime begins at d>=ceil(ell/2), so d-c>=1/2 and every averaged argument is strictly positive. The very short regime uses the tapered coarse estimate.

objections_and_dispositions.issue: Potential omitted outward atom interactions at the two ell parities
objections_and_dispositions.disposition: Resolved by exact identity ceil(c)+ceil(ell/2)=ell at both parities. Additional positivity-repair interactions are covered by D7.

objections_and_dispositions.issue: Quadrature lemma initially stated only for compact support but used on b
objections_and_dispositions.disposition: Resolved in final proof text and independently justified in the review. Integrable BV functions follow by cell summation and absolute convergence; exponential tails justify passage to the limit.

objections_and_dispositions.issue: Structured bound D13 was displayed only through N/2
objections_and_dispositions.disposition: Resolved in final proof text. D14 is at most S at the onset, so the structured bound also holds for every non-opposite long lag with w=0.

objections_and_dispositions.issue: Alternate crude constants in preliminary independent reconstruction differ from frozen constants
objections_and_dispositions.disposition: The preliminary note is expressly provisional. The accepted review reconstructs and verifies the actual frozen receipt A=512, B=256, B0=1026, D0=514, N0=2^60, K_minus=2572, K_plus=1.

objections_and_dispositions.issue: A physical Sidon bound might silently assume integer objective mass in the upper companion
objections_and_dispositions.disposition: Resolved by checking Chen's finite-positive-measure lemma and scalar quadratic directly. The SDP trace transfer and unique positive root argument hold for every nonnegative real kappa.

limitations: This is a mathematical research proof review, not a machine-checked formalization.
Novelty, priority, significance and publication readiness are separate decisions.
No physical Sidon-set construction, stronger-relaxation barrier or external publication approval follows.
